title: Shirya matsala Poly-Glot MCP haɗin gwiwa, tantancewa da kayan aiki
intro: Gyara-mataki-mataki don hanyoyin haɗin HTTP masu rafi mai nisa a cikin ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Goose, Lambar VS, Windsurf da sauran abokan cinikin MCP masu jituwa. Duk abokan ciniki suna amfani da uwar garken Poly-Glot iri ɗaya, tare da kayan aikin 15 a cikin samfura, kwatance, ƙirar al'ada, da harsuna.
endpointLabel: Samar da URL na MCP - yi amfani da ainihin adireshin HTTPS
quickTitle: Fara da waɗannan cak guda huɗu
quick1: Yi amfani da ainihin URL ɗin uwar garken.
Manna ƙarshen HTTPS a sama, gami da
; kar a liƙa Glama, MCP.so ko adireshin adireshin GitHub.
quick2: Zaɓi HTTP mai nisa mai nisa.
Zaɓi zaɓi na MCP HTTP na abokin ciniki. An shirya Poly-Glot: ba a shigar da npm, tashar mai masaukin baki, ko umarnin stdio da ake buƙata.
quick3: Yi izini kuma kunna kayan aikin.
Kammala duk wani sa-hannun shiga ko izini, yarda da izinin kayan aiki, sannan sake sabunta ko sake duba sabar a cikin abokin cinikin ku.
quick4: don duba gwaji da kasancewar Pro.
clientsTitle: Shirya matsala ta abokin ciniki na MCP
clientChatgpt: Yi amfani da ƙa'idodi ko ƙa'idodin MCP masu haɓakawa da ke samuwa ga asusunku ko filin aiki. Ƙara URL na nesa, kammala kowane izini, kayan aikin bincika kuma zaɓi ƙa'idar a cikin tattaunawar ku. Samuwar aikace-aikace da yanayin mai haɓakawa ya bambanta ta tsari da izinin sararin aiki.
clientClaude: Ƙara Poly-Glot a ƙarƙashin Saituna → Masu haɗawa azaman mai haɗin nesa na al'ada. Idan bai bayyana a cikin taɗi ba, kunna shi a menu na kayan aikin ku. Ba a saita masu haɗin nesa ta amfani da fayil ɗin JSON na gida Claude Desktop stdio.
clientCursor: Buɗe saitunan uwar garken MCP ɗin ku, ƙara sabar HTTP mai ratsawa mai nisa ta amfani da ƙarshen ƙarshen sama, kuma kunna shi. Idan babu kayan aikin da aka jera, sabunta sabar MCP, yarda da izini kuma tabbatar da abokin ciniki yana goyan bayan wannan jigilar.
clientGoose: Ƙara Poly-Glot azaman tsawo na MCP mai nisa ta amfani da HTTP mai gudana maimakon umarnin gida. Kunna tsawaita, sake kunna zamansa idan ya cancanta kuma gwada kayan aikin karantawa kawai kafin gwada Aika ko kayan aikin ƙirar ƙira.
clientVscode: A cikin saitin lambar VS mai iya MCP, ƙara URL azaman sabar MCP na HTTP mai nisa, ba tsarin stdio na gida ba. Bincika amincewar filin aiki da amincewar kayan aiki, sannan sake sabunta uwar garken kuma tabbatar da gano kayan aiki.
clientOther: Tabbatar da sigar abokin cinikin ku tana goyan bayan sabar HTTP MCP mai nisa mai gudana. Yi amfani da URL ɗin samarwa kuma kunna kayan aikin sa; idan abokin ciniki yana goyan bayan stdio ko SSE na gado kawai, tuntuɓi takaddun MCP na nesa na yanzu.
errorsTitle: Kuskuren MCP na gama gari da gyare-gyare
error1Title: Babu uwar garken, haɗin ya kasa ko 404
error1Body: URL da jigilar HTTP mai nisa. Sake ƙara haɗin kuma gwada sake. Mai binciken GET zuwa wurin ƙarshen MCP ba ingantaccen gwajin kayan aiki bane; dole ne abokin ciniki yayi amfani da ka'idar MCP. Duba cibiyar sadarwar abokin ciniki da ƙarshen lafiyar uwar garken; kar a yi kuskuren lissafin adireshi don uwar garken.
error2Body: Yi amfani da kwarara izinin asusun abokin ciniki kuma sake haɗawa idan zaman ya ƙare. Bincika buƙatun tabbatar da uwar garken da izini na abokin ciniki. Kar a taɓa liƙa kalmomin sirri na Apple, alamun API ko rasidun biyan kuɗi cikin taɗi na jama'a, hotunan allo ko fitar da rahotanni.
error3Title: 403 An haramta ko izinin kayan aiki
error3Body: Tabbatar da abokin ciniki ya ba wa wannan mai haɗin izinin yin amfani da kayan aikin da aka nema. Tambayi admin na filin aiki game da manufofi idan ya cancanta. Hakanan 403 na iya yin la'akari da tabbaci ko ƙuntatawa-manufofin asali-ba dole ba biyan kuɗi da ya ƙare.
error4Title: Babu kayan aikin da aka samo, tsohuwar lissafin kayan aiki ko kayan aiki ba a gane su ba
error4Body: Kunna mai haɗawa kuma sabunta ko sake duba kayan aikin. Sabar na yanzu tana tattara kayan aikin 15. Takaitattun kundin adireshi ba sa canza wurin yin rijistar kayan aiki kai tsaye. Gwada
; duba cewa abokin ciniki na MCP zai iya gano kayan aikin nesa.
error5Title: Gwajin ya ƙare, ana buƙatar Pro ko an kai iyakar aika
error5Body: don duba shiga halin yanzu. Gwajin kwanaki uku da app ke gudanarwa yana farawa ne akan Aika cancantar farko; bayan ƙarewa, samun damar kyauta ya ƙunshi samfura masu fasali 25 da Aika-AI guda ɗaya a kowace awa 24 na mirgina. Kwatanta Yanayin, BYOM da sauran fasalulluka na Pro suna buƙatar samun dama mai dacewa. Don warware rashin daidaiton samun biyan kuɗi, shiga tare da asusun da aka haɗa kuma tabbatar ko dawo da biyan kuɗin Apple ɗin ku a cikin app ɗin.
error6Title: 429 ƙimar iyaka, ƙarewar lokaci, 500/502/503 ko kuskuren hanyar sadarwa
error6Body: Sake gwadawa bayan ɗan lokaci kaɗan kuma duba hanyar sadarwar abokin ciniki, kowane wakili ko Tacewar zaɓi, da matsayin uwar garken. Guji maimaita abin da aka biya ko Aika har sai kun bincika ko buƙatar da ta gabata ta cika. Haɗa lokacin, abokin ciniki na MCP da lambar kuskure a cikin buƙatun tallafi-kada a haɗa da sirri.
error7Title: Ba daidai ba harshe, fassarar, kwafi ko kuskuren sauti
error7Body: don zaɓar yare mai goyan baya, sannan tabbatar da shigarwar da saitunan harshe na fitarwa. Domin
, tabbatar da tsarin sauti, girman da izini daidai da buƙatun kayan aiki. Gwada
error8Title: Samfurin al'ada (BYOM) inganci ko aiwatarwa ya gaza
error8Body: . Yi amfani da madaidaicin ƙirar HTTPS mai isa, madaidaicin adaftar da mai gano samfuri, da ingantaccen takaddun shaida na ɗan lokaci. Bincika martanin API na mai bada samfurin ku. Kar a raba maɓallan API a cikin rajistan ayyukan ko saƙon tallafi.
toolsTitle: Wane kayan aikin MCP zan gwada?
toolsIntro: Gwada ƙaramin aikin karantawa kawai kafin aikin Aika. Waɗannan ƙungiyoyi sun ƙunshi duk kayan aikin MCP 15 Poly-Glot.
supportBody: Raba abokin cinikin ku na MCP, nau'in sufuri, sunan kayan aiki, ainihin lambar kuskure da kusan lokaci-ba kalmar sirri ko maɓallan API ba.
